description: Tests: optimal_f with max_leverage cap and fallback_pct
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC CLUSTER E05: Optimal f Dynamic Sizing
# Tests: optimal_f(max_leverage=2, min_trades=30, fallback_pct=8)
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === SIGNAL: EMA trend ===
fast = ma(period=20, type=MAType.ema)(close)
slow = ma(period=50, type=MAType.ema)(close)

is_bullish = fast > slow
is_bearish = fast < slow

held_long = hold_until(is_bullish, is_bearish)
held_short = hold_until(is_bearish, is_bullish)

# === EXECUTION ===
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)

# E05: Optimal f with conservative leverage cap
optimal_f(max_leverage=2, min_trades=30, fallback_pct=8)

# Fixed stop for risk control
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=7)
